scope: Offline retrieval screen only. No production activation, Mistral fallback, 1024-dimension migration, or write to the source database.

model.family: local Ollama nomic-embed-text tag; underlying release not separately resolved
model.normalization: L2 unit normalization after inference; nearest-neighbor metric is L2 over normalized vectors.

context.prompt_length_measure: Ollama API prompt_eval_count from one-input-per-request responses; record character and UTF-8 byte lengths as well.
context.overlength_handling: Abort the run on any input rejected by Ollama; do not retry with truncation.

ollama.request_pattern: One POST /api/embed request per input, sequentially; keep_alive=10m.

corpus.selection: All non-empty rows matching the current profile allowlist, ordered by chunk id; this is the existing 4,732-chunk profile slice, not a sample of the full 270,498-chunk database.
corpus.source_mode: SQLite URI mode=ro; vectors are held in a transient in-memory sqlite-vec index; source database is never modified.

evaluation.primary_metric: Exact normalized expected-title retrieval at rank 1 and within top 5 for the 10 covered queries, with all 10 target titles verified present in the frozen corpus before inference.
evaluation.secondary_outputs: Store per-query top-5 chunk ids, title hashes, L2 distances, and group. Store per-input prompt_eval_count, character/byte lengths, and SHA-256 of raw float32 embedding bytes.

interpretation_limits: The 48 records are hand-authored probes from three existing exploratory artifacts, not blind independent gold labels; 10 covered expected-title labels support only a narrow recall screen.
The corpus is the 4,732-row profile-filtered slice, not the complete 270,498-row library and not a full reindexing trial.
The installed base text model is not the previously measured Nomic Embed v2 MoE; historical v2 MoE scores and distances are not comparable to this model.
The model has 768 dimensions versus the existing 1024-dimensional vector store. This experiment does not define a migration plan or approve production use.
No human relevance adjudication is performed on the new rankings; descriptive distance separation cannot establish a safe retrieval threshold.
